subject: Clarify scan tempo & CVE remediation tracking for Pegasus SOC2 review
content:
From: Alice Murray <alice.murray@pegasusfinance.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Pegasus Security Team <security@pegasusfinance.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: scan cadence + CVE tracking detail for SOC2 pack

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the earlier call. Pegasus is preparing the SOC2 evidence packet and our security reviewers asked for a compact deliverable that covers:

- current automated vulnerability scan cadence (internal + 3rd-party coverage)
- SLAs for CVE triage and remediation by severity (P1/P2/P3 definitions)
- concrete proof points for recent high-severity CVE remediation (we referenced CVE-3895 in the questionnaire)

Can you send a single artifact (or a short packet) that summarizes the above and includes exact dates for the CVE remediation steps? Our audit is this Thursday 21 May and anything you can share quickly will help.

Best,
Alice
Alice Murray
Senior Information Security Manager
Pegasus Finance

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Murray <alice.murray@pegasusfinance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: scan cadence + CVE tracking detail for SOC2 pack

Alice —

Thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Marissa (Security Program) and Laura (Engineering ops) to assemble a concise packet. We can provide:

1) A one-page scan cadence summary (weekly internal scans, nightly SCA, monthly 3rd-party scans)
2) SLA table for triage/remediation by severity (we map to P1/P2/P3) with typical RTOs
3) A remediation timeline for CVE-3895 with timestamps and artifact references (scan output, patch PR, deploy, verification)

Marissa — can you pull the verified artifacts and an export from our tracking board? Laura — can you confirm the deployment verification timestamp and attach the kernel CVE patch note?

We should have a compact packet by tomorrow EOD. If Pegasus needs anything in a specific format for the SOC auditor, flag it and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: peg_scan_outline_draft.txt]

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: scan cadence + CVE tracking detail for SOC2 pack

Ben/Laura —

Working on this now. Quick notes (so Alice understands what we will include):

- Scan cadence: Internal weekly auth and infra scans (Nessus internal runner), nightly SCA (Dependabot + internal SBOM checks), monthly external/3rd-party attack surface scans (Cobalt/Detectify).
- Ownership: Security team owns weekly scan triage, EngOps coordinates remediation windows and verifies fixes.
- CVE mapping: We attach our ticket trail for CVE-3895 (RED-4201) showing assignment, PR link, patch date and verification steps.

I'll export the ticket timeline + scan report (PDF) and prepare a remediation spreadsheet that explicitly maps dates to each step (assign -> patch -> test -> prod deploy -> verification).

Attaching initial scan export (pegasus_vm_scan_2026-05.pdf) and draft SLA matrix (sla_matrix_v2.csv). Full remediation plan for CVE-3895 will follow in an XLSX with PR links.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pegasus_vm_scan_2026-05.pdf]
[Attachment: sla_matrix_v2.csv]

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: scan cadence + CVE tracking detail for SOC2 pack

Ben/Marissa —

Added the final verification artifacts for CVE-3895. Timeline below (exported from our deployment audit log):

- 2026-04-26T03:47:22Z: Vulnerability detected by nightly SCA (internal ID SCA-1589).
- 2026-04-27T08:12:05Z: Issue created (RED-4201) and assigned to infra team (owner: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com).
- 2026-04-29T14:02:00Z: Patch PR opened (PR #5512) — links included in XLSX.
- 2026-05-03T22:30:00Z: Patch merged to staging and smoke tests started.
- 2026-05-07T05:06:12Z: Production deploy window (canary) — rollout completed by 2026-05-07T05:29:30Z.
- 2026-05-07T06:10:00Z: Post-deploy verification scan (internal) — no findings for CVE-3895.

I've attached the remediation workbook (cve_3895_remediation_plan.xlsx) that includes PR links, test run IDs, and the verification scan log snippet. Also added the SLA matrix as requested.

Laura Bennett
Engineering Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: cve_3895_remediation_plan.xlsx]

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Murray <alice.murray@pegasusfinance.com>
Cc: Pegasus Security Team <security@pegasusfinance.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Clarify scan tempo & CVE remediation tracking for Pegasus SOC2 review

Alice —

Attached is the packet we prepared for Pegasus' SOC2 auditors. Contents:

1) peg_scan_summary.pdf — one page scan cadence & ownership summary
2) pegasus_vm_scan_2026-05.pdf — exported March-May scan snapshots (redacted IPs)
3) sla_matrix_v2.csv — triage & remediation SLAs by severity (P1: <48h triage, <14d fix; P2: <72h triage, <30d fix; P3: <7d triage, next maintenance window)
4) cve_3895_remediation_plan.xlsx — full CVE-3895 timeline with PR links, test IDs, and verification scan log

We redacted customer-sensitive fields from the scan export. If the auditor needs the raw scan XML or a signed attestation letter, let us know and we will escalate to Legal for a short attestation statement.

Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: peg_scan_summary.pdf, pegasus_vm_scan_2026-05.pdf, sla_matrix_v2.csv, cve_3895_remediation_plan.xlsx]

From: Tom Gupta <t.gupta@pegasusfinance.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alice Murray <alice.murray@pegasusfinance.com>
Cc: Pegasus Security Team <security@pegasusfinance.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify scan tempo & CVE remediation tracking for Pegasus SOC2 review

Ben / Team —

Received, thank you. The packet looks good and covers what our auditors asked for. Two small asks before we close the loop:

1) Can you convert the SLA matrix into a signed single-page attestation on Redwood letterhead (we'll include it in the binder)?
2) Can you confirm whether you will continue monthly external attack surface scans with the same provider (Cobalt) for the next 12 months — auditors prefer a defined provider commitment.

If you can get those two items by EOD tomorrow (21 May) we'll be able to finalize the SOC2 binder.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Gupta
Security Audit Coordinator | Pegasus Finance
